The shapes TestOracle found where the current rules alone keep a secret that
the baseline rules, and so v1, remove, as secrets of a class whose name starts
with oracle_gap_. No rule is changed for them here (card LG-12): TestOracle
holds the current rules to the baseline on every other class, and fails when a
gap class has no violation left, so a rule change that closes one (LG-26)
moves its cases to the class of their shape. Until then the switch
redaction_current_rules_only keeps these secrets. See README.md for the format.

Each class is a shape of code that the current rules keep on purpose (the
exceptions plainCode in redact.go lists) and the baseline rules remove. A
secret can take any of them, so each is a gap; oracleGapShapes in
oracle_test.go names them all, with an example of each exception.

regex_value: the value of a secret-looking key that reads as a regular
expression literal: it starts with '/', holds a metacharacter such as '+', and
ends with '/' and perhaps flags. A base64 key can start with '/'.

yaml_alias: a password made of words after a '*', which reads as a YAML
alias, the value of a key after ':' with nothing after it on the line.

name_index: a password made of words, as a name, a member path or an
instance variable, followed by an index, a literal or a block, as in
hunterTwo[x9]. The baseline rules leave the index and remove the name.

type_annotation: any value of letters and digits, random ones too, followed
by what reads as an assignment or a union of types, as in a type annotation:
" = <value>" or " | <name>".

=== secret oracle_gap_regex_value yaml key with a value that starts with a slash
SECRET_KEY: '⟦/Qm7Rt2+Wx9¦Lp4Zk8Vn3Bc/n⟧'

=== secret oracle_gap_regex_value yaml key with no space after the colon
db_password:'⟦/Hv3Kd8+Pz1Ty¦6Wq0Ln5Rb/u⟧'

=== secret oracle_gap_regex_value key with spaces around the equals sign and no flags
SecretKey = '⟦/kaR4Wfn+P2tY¦JmoCLEQzsdVb/⟧'

=== secret oracle_gap_regex_value aws secret access key shorter than the aws rule takes
aws_secret_access_key = '⟦/Zp3Lc7+Mt1Qx¦5Bv9Nk2Rh6Jw/g⟧'

=== secret oracle_gap_regex_value indented yaml token
service:
  access_token: '⟦/Tp6Mw1+Rg4Ls¦8Ny3Bk7Ch/i⟧'

=== secret oracle_gap_yaml_alias password of two words and a digit after a star
password: '⟦*Summer2¦Winter⟧'

=== secret oracle_gap_yaml_alias indented yaml secret
db:
  password: '⟦*Blue7¦Moon⟧'
  port: 5432

=== secret oracle_gap_yaml_alias client secret of two words and digits
client_secret: '⟦*Orange4¦Tiger9⟧'

=== secret oracle_gap_yaml_alias passphrase of words joined by underscores
secret: '⟦*correct_horse¦_battery⟧'

=== secret oracle_gap_yaml_alias token with no space after the colon
api_token:'⟦*Falcon3¦Harbor⟧'

=== secret oracle_gap_name_index two words before an index
password: '⟦hunter¦Two⟧'[x9]

=== secret oracle_gap_name_index member path before an index
password: '⟦Summer.¦Winter⟧'[2]

=== secret oracle_gap_name_index instance variable before an index after a spaced equals sign
db_password = '⟦@maple_¦copper⟧'[i]

=== secret oracle_gap_name_index two words before a literal
api_key: '⟦canyon¦River⟧'{ab}

=== secret oracle_gap_name_index member path before a block
secret: '⟦Walnut.¦Cobalt⟧' { x }

=== secret oracle_gap_type_annotation random token before an assignment
password: '⟦Xk9mP2¦vLq7Rt⟧' = 1

=== secret oracle_gap_type_annotation random token before a union with none
secret: '⟦aB3dE5¦fG7hJ2⟧' | None

=== secret oracle_gap_type_annotation chained assignment
api_key = '⟦Qw8Er4¦Ty6Ui2Op⟧' = None

=== secret oracle_gap_type_annotation token with no space after the colon
ACCESS_TOKEN:'⟦Lm3Nb7¦Vc1Xz5Kj⟧' = x

=== secret oracle_gap_type_annotation indented token before a union
  client_secret: '⟦Hg5Fd2¦Sa8Qw4Er⟧' | str
